strategies.name: Earnings Drift With Text Surprise
strategies.hypothesis: The market underreacts to numeric earnings surprise, guidance language, and earnings-call text.
strategies.entry_rule: Positive numeric and text surprise with supportive overnight move and no broad risk-off shock.
strategies.exit_rule: Time exit after 5-15 trading days or earlier when residual alpha decays.
risk_notes: Point-in-time transcript and release timestamps are mandatory.
Cap sector and earnings-season concentration.
Reject illiquid contracts or shares when spread cost overwhelms expected drift.

strategies.name: Announcement-Aware Reversal
strategies.hypothesis: Extreme non-news residual moves partially reverse when caused by liquidity pressure rather than information.
strategies.entry_rule: Fade extreme residual extensions only when no earnings/news/macro event explains the move.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit on 1-3 day mean reversion, new information, or volatility stop.
risk_notes: Never blindly fade earnings repricing.
Kill trade on fresh catalyst.
Use wider friction assumptions in high-volatility tapes.

strategies.name: Sector-Filtered Medium-Term Momentum
strategies.hypothesis: Intermediate winners continue when sector and regime filters avoid momentum crash conditions.
strategies.entry_rule: Rank liquid names by medium-term momentum with sector confirmation and no imminent earnings event.
strategies.exit_rule: Rebalance on schedule or exit when momentum rank/regime deteriorates.
risk_notes: Momentum can crash during sharp market rebounds.
Control turnover and sector concentration.
Use this as a portfolio/ranking layer before a scalp trigger.

strategies.name: Relative-Volume Breakout Or Failure
strategies.hypothesis: Volatility compression plus volume expansion predicts continuation, while failed holds beyond obvious levels predict reversal.
strategies.entry_rule: Trade continuation only when RVOL, VWAP slope, and sector confirmation align; fade failed breaches that close back inside range.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit on close back inside range, VWAP target, time stop, or invalidation of breached level.
risk_notes: Reject information-rich gaps unless strategy is event-specific.
Avoid hindsight level selection in backtests.
Use strict size limits in high-attention names.

strategies.name: Overnight Momentum Basket
strategies.hypothesis: Momentum returns concentrate in the close-to-open window for diversified liquid baskets.
strategies.entry_rule: Enter diversified momentum basket near close while excluding event-risk names.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit next open or maintain rolling overnight basket if rank persists.
risk_notes: Strict overnight gross exposure limits required.
Auction slippage can erase edge.
No live use until open/close execution assumptions are validated.

strategies.name: ETF Flow Dislocation Basket
strategies.hypothesis: Extreme ETF creations/redemptions create non-fundamental stock-level demand shocks that partially reverse.
strategies.entry_rule: Fade extreme non-fundamental flow exposure while controlling factor and sector exposures.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit as flow pressure normalizes or after fixed reversion horizon.
risk_notes: Advanced data requirement.
Borrow and factor exposure must be modeled.
Use as watchlist/context layer before execution.

strategies.name: Options-Led Relative Strength
strategies.hypothesis: Liquid options markets sometimes lead stock returns through informed demand and volatility/skew changes.
strategies.entry_rule: Follow stock names where liquid option signals and price action align, avoiding unmodeled binary events.
strategies.exit_rule: Exit when option lead dissipates, after 1-5 days, or on chain-quality degradation.
risk_notes: Requires Tradier or equivalent options data.
Do not assume every gamma narrative is actionable.
Chain quality gate is mandatory.

strategies.name: Retail Attention Burst
strategies.hypothesis: Speculative attention bursts can continue briefly while flow accelerates, then reverse sharply after attention peaks.
strategies.entry_rule: Paper only: classify continuation versus exhaustion after attention and price acceleration.
strategies.exit_rule: Very short duration, hard stop, no averaging down.
risk_notes: Dangerous per unit of hype.
Tiny paper size only until slippage model is proven.
Live promotion should be exceptional.
